notes.title: Change Log Alpha 0.2:
notes.content:
1) Added variability on the first day. (At the request of the community).
2) Replaced some of the art of the first day.
3) Fixed grammar and spelling errors in the first day.
4) Fixed the sound of the elevator, which did not turn off after exiting it.
5) Fixed a bug, when you click the remember button. (There was no voice acting in the game).
Added:
1) 2 day.
2) New music menu from composer Crymon.
